messages:
meera: Quick sync — new candidate ARGO-40B landed in the model registry. Need a short scorecard + bring-up checklist for next-week model review. TLDR: promising throughput but unknown quantization stability. Please add 1-5 scores for: quality (LLM-bench), quant-robustness, infra-fit (fp16/int8), rollout-risk. Tag me by EOD Fri.

sanjay: Added a row in the intake sheet. Which eval sets should we run? convo-evals + summarization? :eyes:

ana: I can run an int8 sweep on the GTX-A100 pool and try an int4 baseline (no QAT) to see failure modes. ETA ~48h.

riley: Heads up — ARGO tokenizer uses a slightly different BPE merge table. We should do tokenization-compat checks before any fine-tune/quant tests. Could cause off-by-one inputs.

meera: Good catch. Add tokenizer check to the checklist. Eval command I'm going to use to standardize results: 
```
./run_eval.sh --model argo-40b --tasks convo,summ --quant int8,int4 --seed 42 --out /tmp/argo_eval.json
```

eval-bot: Job queued: eval-9762 (arty). Queue position 3. Est run time ~6h. Logs -> https://logs.internal/exec/9762

sanjay: For prioritization scoring (prelim): quality 4, quant-robustness 3, infra-fit 4, rollout-risk 2. Note: good perf on fp16, int8 looks workable but needs stability checks. Suggest Dedicated canary only.

meera: Thanks. Draft bring-up checklist (short):
1) Tokenizer compatibility test (vocab/mapping diffs)
2) Quant sweep (int8 + int4 quick pass) on GTX-A100 pool
3) Eval regression gating: delta <= 0.05 absolute on primary convo metric; run on conv-eval + summarization sets
4) Perf SLOs: p95 latency < 250ms @bs1 for hosted target; mem footprint < 48GB for Dedicated nodes
5) Canary plan: Dedicated-only canary, 100rps -> 1k rps over 48h with rollback hooks
6) Security / KMS config review for Private deployments
Ping @oncall before canary. :thumbsup:

riley: Pushed small tokenizer compat patch in branch `riley/token-fix-argo`. PTAL. Also found a subtle pad-token mismatch in the HF tokenizer file.

ana: int4 run failed on ~0.8% of samples, stack traces saved to /artifacts/argo/int4_failures.tar.gz. Attaching minimal repro in the ticket.

eval-bot: eval-9762 finished. Summary: quality delta vs baseline = -0.03 (better), latency p95 = 210ms @bs1, int8 memory = 42GB, int4 unstable for ~0.8% inputs. Full results -> https://results.internal/argo/9762.json

meera: Solid results. Lowering rollout-risk to 1 based on int8 stability and perf. I'll slot ARGO-40B into next Wednesday's model review for final sign-off. Thanks everyone!
